verdict.rationale: Paddle documents a fast path to a working payment flow. Overlay checkout via Paddle.js requires 'minimal frontend coding', and official server SDKs exist for Node.js, Python, Go and PHP, with built-in webhook verification helpers. A sandbox, a Postman collection covering every operation, and a Next.js starter kit that yields 'a working three-tier subscription app' round out the path. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of copy-paste code snippets per language in the guides, any evidence supporting the under-a-day time-to-integrate claim, and independent or hands-on corroboration of integration speed.
